ASTOLFORIDER-REASON_EVAPORATED_RELIC.des: #At combat start, gain 30 NP Charge and prepare the Caprice bag. Draw 1 Caprice each turn; fulfill up to 1 per turn.
ASTOLFORIDER-REASON_EVAPORATED_RELIC.fla: Reason did not disappear. It simply found something more entertaining to do.
ASTOLFORIDER-COMPLETELY_EVAPORATED_REASO: #Replaces Evaporated Reason D+. Start combat with 50 NP Charge. The first fulfilled Caprice each turn grants 10 NP Charge and 10 Critical Stars.
A perfect absence of hesitation—and, perhaps, of directions.
#Earn Bond from rooms and victories. Bond grants Max HP; at level 4 start with 20 NP Charge, at 7 also 20 Critical Stars, and at 10 every player gains 1 Evasion while Astolfo gains 10 NP Charge.
Strength matters less than arriving when somebody needs you.
#At card rewards you may give up the card to roll for an NP duplicate. A duplicate raises NP level; failed rolls build pity and grant consolation.
Its pages remember what its owner cheerfully forgot.
ASTOLFORIDER-CHALICE_OF_THE_TWELVE_PALAD: #Gain !MaxHp! Max HP. Bond can reach level 12 and NP level can reach 6.
Twelve reflections crowd a cup meant for one hero.
ASTOLFORIDER-HIPPOGRIFF_FEATHER.title: Hippogriff Feather
ASTOLFORIDER-HIPPOGRIFF_FEATHER.descript: #The first Quick played each combat grants 20 Critical Stars.
ASTOLFORIDER-HIPPOGRIFF_FEATHER.flavor: A pale feather that never agrees which side of the world it occupies.
ASTOLFORIDER-TRIFAS_RIBBON.title: Trifas Ribbon
ASTOLFORIDER-TRIFAS_RIBBON.description: #Start combat with 6 Block. The first fulfilled Caprice each combat grants 10 NP Charge.
ASTOLFORIDER-TRIFAS_RIBBON.flavor: Tied in a hurry, treasured without hesitation.
ASTOLFORIDER-GOLDEN_ARGALIA_POINT.title: Golden Point of Argalia
ASTOLFORIDER-GOLDEN_ARGALIA_POINT.descri: #The first time you apply Weak each turn, gain 10 Critical Stars.
ASTOLFORIDER-GOLDEN_ARGALIA_POINT.flavor: Even blunt, the golden lance remembers how to send a rider tumbling.
ASTOLFORIDER-DOODLED_MANUAL.title: Manual Full of Doodles
ASTOLFORIDER-DOODLED_MANUAL.description: #The first time each combat a card removes your debuff or an enemy offensive buff, gain 1 Artifact and 20 NP Charge.
ASTOLFORIDER-DOODLED_MANUAL.flavor: The useful spell is somewhere between a rabbit and three smiling suns.
#The first Evasion consumed each turn refunds 10 Critical Stars.
Proof that absence can still leave something shining behind.
ASTOLFORIDER-BORROWED_ACHILLES_SHIELD.de: #The first time each combat Astolfo falls to half HP or less, every player gains 8 Block and Astolfo gains 1 Evasion.
ASTOLFORIDER-BORROWED_ACHILLES_SHIELD.fl: Returned eventually. Probably. Adventures make schedules difficult.
ASTOLFORIDER-ADVENTURE_BAG.title: Adventure Bag
ASTOLFORIDER-ADVENTURE_BAG.description: #At combat start choose: gain 30 NP Charge, gain 30 Critical Stars, or choose the first Caprice.
ASTOLFORIDER-ADVENTURE_BAG.flavor: Everything needed for a journey, except a reason to turn back.
